rationale: The assistant correctly identified the post-pyrolytic lock as normal, told the customer not to force the door, and used the fan-running/warm-glass evidence to confirm the oven was still cooling, matching the hidden truth. It slightly over-reached by speculating about 'a mechanical fault with the lock motor or latch' as a conditional possibility, and it never gave the fallback path of a mains power reset and contacting AEG customer care if the lock fails to release once cool. No fabrication, no parts, no loops; a UK homeowner would be well served.
